proposed_fixes.title: Guard theme-resource lookup during system-theme transitions
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A WPF resource lookup may dereference a resource that is unavailable during a theme change; this is low confidence because no stack frame or process is identified.
plan: Identify the failing process and theme-change callback from the captured stack.
If the fault is in PowerToys, tolerate a temporarily unavailable resource dictionary and retain the prior theme until replacement resources are ready.
Add a regression test for a theme change while the affected view initializes.
verification: Reproduce on latest stable while changing Windows light/dark theme.
Verify the affected window stays open and no matching exception is logged.

information_gaps.information: Which process/window throws, exact current PowerToys version, and whether the same theme-change sequence reproduces on latest stable.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a PowerToys resource race from an unrelated WPF process and avoids proposing a fix in the wrong component.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm About version and visible window; if it reproduces, repeat the theme change and comment `/bugreport` immediately.

comment.body: Thanks for including the exception and Windows theme-change context. The stack does not identify whether a PowerToys process throws it. Could you confirm the PowerToys version shown in About and, if it still occurs on latest stable, which PowerToys window is open when changing Windows between light and dark? Please add `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing. This will determine whether the resource lookup is in PowerToys and which UI path needs investigation.
